dataset.name: Guangxi treatment-naive MIBC cohort (GSE216037)
dataset.description: Independent muscle-invasive bladder-cancer cohort with primary-tumor bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The First Affiliated Hospital of Guangxi Medical University enrolled 52 patients with pathologist-confirmed muscle-invasive bladder cancer between February 2018 and October 2019. Every patient contributes one treatment-naive primary-tumor RNA profile with complete positive overall-survival time and status.
dataset.publication_citation: Tao et al. Frontiers in Genetics 2022

metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and the CC BY 4.0 publication
metadata.library_method: TruSeq whole-transcriptome RNA sequencing of treatment-naive primary MIBC; reads were filtered with fastp, aligned to hg19 with HISAT2 and assembled with StringTie/Cufflinks before RPKM calculation
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-provided overall survival in months for 52 treatment-naive MIBC patients
metadata.endpoint_caveat: GEO publishes exact individual OS duration and state but does not define whether follow-up begins at diagnosis, admission, surgery or sampling. TRACE Explorer preserves the source endpoint without claiming a harmonized clinical origin.
metadata.sample_selection_note: The source provides exactly one BC1-BC52 primary-tumor RNA profile per patient. All 52 records have positive OS time and a binary survival state; no sample-selection fallback is required.
metadata.expression_processing_note: The source matrix contains 34,372 unique case-insensitive gene symbols and RPKM values for BC1-BC52. TRACE Explorer selects all endpoint-complete columns and applies log2(RPKM + 1).
metadata.clinical_covariate_note: GEO exposes sex and grade. Age is supplied only as Young, Old or unknown rather than an exact numeric value and is therefore not registered as an age covariate.
metadata.overlap_note: The Guangxi cohort is institutionally and accession-wise distinct from the promoted IMvigor210, Northwestern, UNC and UROMOL bladder-cancer releases.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the pinned public GEO files in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Treatment-naive primary muscle-invasive bladder tumor, one bulk RNA profile per patient

expression.label: GEO gene-level RPKM transformed to log2(RPKM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided SYMBOL1 column in the pinned GEO matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All 34,372 source gene symbols are non-empty and unique under case-insensitive comparison, so no aggregation or ambiguity exclusion is required.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer applies log2(RPKM + 1) to source-provided gene-level RPKM. Values are intended for within-cohort analysis and are not cross-study normalized.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause as encoded by survival state (1 = death; 0 = censored)
